purpose: test whether a physically interpreted multi-hop service-acquisition dwell, rather than an artificial plan bonus, restores a nontrivial public commitment trade-off
physical_rationale: A task-service chain must remain continuously effective while sensing, relaying and execution are acquired. This dwell is the same for every plan and branch; pre-positioning changes only whether the physical chain is available early enough to satisfy it.
selection_rule: Select no contract unless high-reliability staging and low-reliability maintenance both have a directionally supported paired advantage and the high-reliability staged branch remains noncollapsed.
boundary: Calibration only; no policy is trained and no method claim is allowed.
